summary: SOL Strategies Inc., a Toronto-based digital asset infrastructure company, furnished a Form 6-K with a news release dated September 22, 2026, announcing that its wholly-owned Houdini Swap unit crossed US$3 billion in cumulative swap volume since launch. Volume rose from just under US$2.8 billion at end-June 2026, when Houdini's June 1 acquisition closed; over US$260 million came from 150,000-plus orders post-close across 120+ networks. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is involved. Operationally routine disclosure; no deal or risk-arb angle.
